mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 58 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Badger Ridge Middle School. We have a first quarter moon tonight, an overnight low of 42 degrees, and no rain in the forecast. Keep your eyes on the sky at 4:57 AM for a 2-minute ISS flyover, moving from Mount Horeb toward Fitchburg and Madison, appearing almost directly overhead.

Verona property owners can now apply for a stormwater utility credit by using rain gardens or barrels to help manage runoff. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is looking for feedback regarding a bus incident, so please contact them if you have information.
Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with fun including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the police report, on October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after dangerous driving was reported; no students were injured during the incident.
Today's flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and the store is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a delicious dessert.
